description: Angular component for configuring a Flot basic chart widget, including form setup, data handling, and UI logic.

classes.name: FlotBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent for configuring Flot chart widgets.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget configuration.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default data keys for the widget, e.g., temperature.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and saves the widget configuration based on form data.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on other control values.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons to display, e.g., fullscreen.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Configures card button visibility based on selected options.
